All 8 passengers from cancelled ZX 400 are rebooked, with each booking group on one flight and in its original cabin.

| Booking | Passengers | Cabin | New flight |
|---|---|---|---|
| HZ4K7Q | Jan, Maja, Luka Horvat | Economy | ZX 404 (2026-11-03 07:00) |
| RS2M9D | Elena, Marco Rossi | Business | ZX 406 (2026-11-03 10:00) |
| NV8P2L | Anna Novak | Economy | ZX 402 (2026-11-02 18:00) |
| BG5J3R | Tom Berger | Economy | ZX 402 (2026-11-02 18:00) |
| LD9C6W | Sara Lind | Business | ZX 402 (2026-11-02 18:00) |

ZX 402 was the earliest FRA→JFK flight after the cancellation. It could only take the three singles, because it has 2 economy and 1 business seat. ZX 404 has 3 economy and no business seats, so it fit the Horvats. ZX 406 has 6 economy and 4 business seats, so it fit the Rossis. ZX 402 is now full in both cabins, and ZX 404 and ZX 406 each have seats left. The ZX 400 passenger list now shows no passengers.

conversation.content: Flight ZX 400 from Frankfurt (FRA) to New York (JFK) is cancelled. Rebook all of its passengers. Everyone keeps their cabin. Passengers with the same booking reference travel together on one flight. Put each booking group on the earliest flight on the same route that has enough free seats in its cabin for the whole group.
